## Beyond the Classroom

This section contains optional resources for students who want to explore astronomy further. None of this material is required, but you might find it interesting!

## Astronomy in the News

*Links to recent discoveries and news articles will be posted here.*

## Useful Resources

- [NASA Science: Electromagnetic Spectrum](https://science.nasa.gov/ems/){data-proofer-ignore="true"} — Interactive tour of the EM spectrum with videos and activities
- [NASA Universe](https://science.nasa.gov/universe/){data-proofer-ignore="true"} — NASA's portal for all things cosmic
- [NASA Astronomy Picture of the Day](https://apod.nasa.gov/){data-proofer-ignore="true"}
- [ESA/Hubble Image Archive](https://esahubble.org/images/)
- [JWST Image Gallery](https://webbtelescope.org/images){data-proofer-ignore="true"}
- [Astrobites](https://astrobites.org)
- [ViewSpace](https://viewspace.org) — Interactive space and astronomy visualizations
